summary: Game Dev Tycoon entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Game Dev Tycoon
entries.definitive_edition: Current PC release with mod/build/save state documented

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current PC build with exact mod/save state documented

primary.version: Current Steam/GOG PC release with mod state documented
primary.why: The PC route is the original and most flexible route for Workshop/mods, save inspection, and capture. Mobile/Switch ports are valid access routes but alter input and platform constraints.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current PC release. Record storefront/build, mods/Workshop state, game length, difficulty/settings, company/save year, platform parody unlocks, anti-piracy/version context if relevant, and whether mobile/Switch ports were compared.

secondary.why: PC is the best archive/capture/mod route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record mods and platform route explicitly.
